*Source: [The City of 7 Seraphs](https://www.drivethrurpg.com/product/269801/The-City-of-7-Seraphs?affiliate_id=549120)*

**Awakened Lifetime (Ex):** At 1st level, the reborn is incarnated with memories of a single lifetime slumbering in their mind. This identity can be of any race, gender, and alignment. The identity is always one of a skilled fighter or martial classed character that fought on behalf of the City, its Parities, or otherwise perished within reach of the Ashborn or the Elder Grove. The character should select a class skill that belonged to the identity that is not normally a class skill, while channeling that identity (see below) the reborn gains access to that skill. At 3rd level, 7th level, 11th level, 15th level, and 19th level the reborn gains another awakened life.

This ability replaces armor training and armor mastery.

**Mastered Knowledges (Ex):** At 1st level, a reborn selects one combat feat for each awakened lifetime they have. This feat is one known to a specific awakened lifetime. At 2nd level, and every even level thereafter each awakened lifetime gets another bonus combat feat. When using the channel lifetime ability the reborn gains access to these feats. This ability can be used to take feats from other Parities but no more than one Parity per awakened lifetime.

This ability replaces all bonus feats.

**Channel Lifetime (Su):** At 1st level, by meditating for fifteen minutes, the reborn can bring a previous lifetime to the front of their memories. This gives them access to that lifetime’s skill bonus and mastered knowledges for 1 hour per reborn level. The reborn can activate this ability once per day and an additional time at 5th level and every 4 levels thereafter.

This ability replaces weapon training and weapon mastery.

**Memory of What Was (Ex):** A reborn may make Knowledge (History) checks untrained. They add a +2 bonus to these checks as memories of ancient battles and old lives inform their thoughts. This bonus increases by +2 at 6th, 10th, 14th, and 18th levels.

This ability replaces bravery.
